title: FDA warns Chinese providers of compounding APIs over record-request refusals
snippet: Neither Chongqing Qiancan Technology nor Tianjin Healthcare Medical Technology provided the records requested by the FDA, leading the agency to issue import alerts and warning letters.

title: PepGen shares almost double as DM1 oligonucleotide achieves ‘best in class’ splicing
snippet: Mean splicing correction for PepGen’s PGN-EDODM1 was 46.5% at week 13, compared to under 30% for competitors like Dyne Therapeutics, Novartis and Ionis Pharmaceuticals.

title: MicroRNAs in aflatoxin B1-associated hepatocellular carcinogenesis: a scoping review of molecular networks, multiomics evidence, machine learning and translational potentials.
snippet: Aflatoxin B1 (AFB) is a foodborne hepatocarcinogen, but it remains unclear whether microRNA dysregulation reflects AFB-associated hepatocarcinogenesis or general hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) biology. title: Gut Microbiota and Cancer Therapy Resistance: Mechanistic Insights with Emphasis on Colorectal Cancer.
